items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] This is Paul Crawford. ... I'll tell you what, not that he was my brother like I told Crawford. ... Go ahead, Crawford. Finish that.

ctx.x: And this is Richard Allen. Manny J. Mello. We're recording this afternoon of August the 3rd, 1959 at 1025 Betholome Street. So we've got your name on there. You call yourself Manny?
